text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- London-based United Bank of Kuwait plans three Islamic investment projects.
- Large rise in credit extended by Kuwait Investment Company.
- Burgan Bank half year results show it has been doing well, says chairman Sheikh Ahmad Abdullah al-Sabah.

- Ministry of Justice creates special department for difficult debts to help debtors settle their obligations and to investigate whether those who have not paid their obligations have assets that they have not declared. The debtors are due to settle by a September 6 deadline the latest in a series of annual instalments in a private sector bad debt recovery programme. The original debt owed to the state amounts to about $20 billion.
- National Bank of Kuwait has been voted best bank in Kuwait by Euromoney magazine for 1996, for the third year running.
- Oil market witnessess sudden tension and prices rise sharply due to military events in northern Iraq.
